_meta.source_name: Alien: Isolation -- official Simplified Chinese localisation
_meta.encoding: UTF-16LE with BOM (NOT utf-8-sig as previously assumed)

corpus_correction.duplicate_explanation: The 704 files under DATA/ENV/PRODUCTION/DLC/<MAP>/TEXT/ENGLISH/ are 11 byte-identical copies of the 64 files in DATA/TEXT/ENGLISH/ (768 paths collapse to 64 md5 hashes). They are NOT separate in-world terminal or signage text.
corpus_correction.inflated_figures_seen_elsewhere: 162,804 keys / 6.75M chars -- these count the 12x duplication (13,565 x 12 = 162,780 keys; 201,328 x 12 = 2,415,936 chars).
corpus_correction.placeholder_explanation: Keys whose value is the key string repeated verbatim, or empty -- untranslated stubs. Excluded from all statistics below.

english_gate_coverage.headline: NO ENGLISH SIDE EXISTS. This is a Chinese-only localisation; the directory named ENGLISH contains only Chinese. Only 19.50% of live keys can be English-gated by any mechanical means.

searched: the localisation tree itself (768 TXT + 3 non-TXT files)
DATA/UI/FONTS_CN.GFX -- compiled Scaleform font library, zero extractable ASCII strings
DATA/FONT_CONFIG.XML and FONT_CONFIG.BML -- font-to-language mapping only, no UI strings
all Steam libraries on C:, F:, G: -- no Alien: Isolation install (appid 214490 absent from every libraryfolders.vdf entry)
C:/Users/Taka/Desktop, Downloads and Documents for a sibling English text tree -- only the 12 copies of the Chinese tree were found
english_mirror_search.result: No English build and no English mirror exists anywhere on this machine. Recovering English by KEY was therefore the only available route.

tier1_key_is_english_sentence.what: The key IS the English source string, e.g. [TEXT_Get to the Airlock] -> 前往气闸舱 and [TEXT_Hold RB to use the Motion Tracker] -> 按住RB键使用运动追踪器. A genuine aligned en/zh pair. All of them are in GLOBAL.TXT.

key_slug_gate.what: The key carries English content words naming the referent, e.g. [TEXT_MOTIONTRACKER] -> 运动追踪器 and [AI_EXTERN_360_PRESENCE_KILLED_BY_ANDROID] -> 被仿生人所杀. The slug is derived from the English source string, so the pairing is observed rather than inferred.
key_slug_gate.strength: hard for the item and UI dictionaries (GLOBAL, UI, EXTERNAL, TUTORIALS); unusable elsewhere
key_slug_gate.excluded_false_gates: Speaker, emotion and scene codes were stoplisted after inspection -- RIP, SAM, ASH, PAR, ELL, DAL, LAM, USE, SIC, SII, CUTSCENES, OBJECTIVE, NAME, SECONDARY and similar carry no information about a string's meaning. The 15 bark files (CV1-CV6, SS1-SS3, G0000-G0003, P0001-P0002) are excluded from this gate wholesale, because their keys are purely speaker+emotion codes.

inline_literal_gate.what: The localisers LEFT the English proper noun inside the Chinese value -- Sevastopol, Seegson, Weyland-Yutani, Nostromo, Torrens, San Cristobal. The English literal is physically present in the string, so the pairing is observed, not inferred. This gate simultaneously documents a T-FROZEN decision made by the official localiser.
inline_literal_gate.strength: hard, but reaches only proper nouns

ungated.what: Voice lines and terminal prose keyed by opaque numeric line IDs (A1_CUTSCENES_SAM_C0100_0004, A1_T0001_TEX_4066, A1_LOC_TEX_2295). The key says who speaks and in what scene, never what the line means.
ungated.rule: Terms attested ONLY here are marked english_gate:false and capped at confidence 'low'. They may CORROBORATE a rendering already attested elsewhere. They may NEVER be the sole basis for adopting one.

english_gate_coverage.limitation_statement: 80.50% of the live keys in this corpus cannot be English-gated at all. Every dialogue file, every terminal-log file and the whole of LOCATIONS.TXT fall in that bucket -- which means every station location name, every ship-log entry and every line of spoken dialogue is ungated. Terms mined from those files are corroboration only and are marked confidence 'low'. The gated 19.50% is concentrated in four files -- GLOBAL.TXT (the item dictionary), UI.TXT, EXTERNAL.TXT (achievement text) and TUTORIALS.TXT -- and every 'high' confidence entry below comes from there.

candidates.alt: bare 'Sevastopol' when used alone; Sevastopol港 (port); Sevastopol航天管制中心 (traffic control)
candidates.source: Alien: Isolation official Simplified Chinese localisation (priority level 3)
candidates.note: The official localisation NEVER transliterates Sevastopol. The Latin string is left verbatim and a Chinese common noun is suffixed with NO separating space ('Sevastopol空间站', 28 keys). Strong independent support for keeping this name T-FROZEN in the RPG -- but note the corpus's Latin-first, no-space joining differs from the project's T-BILINGUAL rule (Chinese first, one ASCII space).

candidates.source: Alien: Isolation official Simplified Chinese localisation (priority level 3)
candidates.note: NOT ATTESTED as 'decontamination'. No key contains DECON or PURGE. Of the 22 keys containing 净化, 21 are the PURGE sense: the reactor/nest purge (A1_M2501_RIP_0440 '启动一次反应堆净化'; A1_M2501_SGF_5368 '系统净化已准备就绪'; A1_M2501_OBJ_9215 '在反应堆控制站启动净化'), the electrical-grid purge (A1_M2102_OBJ_4591 '停止电网净化'), and the Environment Control minigame (A1_TUT_MINIGAME_3_EnvironCTR '使用&dpad&来启动净化'). The single exception is AI_UI_AIR_CONDITIONING -> '空气净化' (air conditioning/purification). So 净化 here means purge or air-purify, never decontaminate. Do not mine decontamination from this source.
